direction_rules: Paired forward/reverse for derivation-bearing loops with genuinely different routes named in the contract; single direction plus an independent skeptic replay from the contract alone for formula-instantiating certificates; statement plus skeptic for statements. Same-author passes are never independent review.
assistants: After each sub-round one research assistant/coder per lens (historical, jung, modern) runs the tests named in the lens updates; outputs live under research/round33/experts/<lens>/assistant-<subround>/ and count zero research loops.
goal_change_rule: After each sub-round's panel update the advisor may reorder, replace or retitle the next pair; the change is recorded in the next selection note and this plan's history field.
contract_rules: Round32 closing-panel rules R1-R10 (freezer enforces R1-R5, R8; gate recorder enforces R6, R7; R9 at integration; R10 by the tier vocabulary below)
every contract names its metric, weights, window and clock in parameters
the (rate, constant) pair of a decay target is frozen before production with a margin of at least 2
scaling brackets are declared per constant
the global Lipschitz constant is never a decay factor
scaling brackets admit every valid form of the declared tau order (linear [95,105], quadratic [9500,10500] unless exact variants justify narrower), declared before production
the margin of at least 2 is a freeze-time property against recorded previews; acceptance is 'proved constant at most the frozen target'
every contract carries new_control_semantics for each control id not defined in an earlier frozen contract
an external theorem is quoted from a committed source excerpt with its PDF hash, never from a report that cites it
a within-family Cauchy target is quantified over all M above N
selected_after never names plan.json; each freeze records plan.json's sha256 in the plan history

gate_fields.whole_sequence_claimed: true only with a non-empty whole_sequence_scope naming the construction
gate_fields.translation_invariance_claimed: true only with a scope naming coarse translations and the construction
gate_fields.node_certificate_restated_for_limit: declared per contract (BC1: AV2 restated for the limit of the named constructions F1/F2; BC2: AX2 restated for the route-B limit); true only with the datum and radius equal to the Round32 gate rationals
gate_fields.sign_certificate_restated_for_limit: declared per contract (BC1: AW2 enclosure restated for the limit of the named constructions)
gate_fields.finite_box_sign_claimed: true only with a non-empty finite_box_sign_scope naming the family, the range of N and the untruncated vectors
gate_fields.finite_box_node_claimed: declared per contract (false in BC1: the admitted AV2 record proves no finite-box node)
gate_fields.correlation_shift_resolved: always false while the free reference e^{-3}/4 lies inside the certified node interval (reference_unresolved)
gate_fields.resolved_interaction_shift: declared per contract and names its observable: false for C(s) in AV2, AX1 and AX2, true for the static Wilson mean omega(W) only in AW2; a contract that restates both AV2 and AW2 exports correlation_shift_resolved instead
